stories.title: Falcons' Pearce suspended 8 games after arrest
stories.summary: Falcons edge rusher James Pearce Jr. will be suspended by the NFL for eight games due to violating the league's personal conduct policy, the league announced Friday afternoon.

stories.title: Seahawks cite positive reviews in adding Arnold
stories.summary: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said one factor in the team's decision to offer Terrion Arnold a contract despite the felony charges he's facing was the "overwhelmingly positive" reviews they heard while vetting the free agent cornerback.

stories.title: Aikman gets Brady-like limits for MNF broadcasts
stories.summary: ESPN analyst Troy Aikman will see some restrictions in the lead-up to "Monday Night Football" broadcasts similar to those for Fox's Tom Brady.

stories.title: Sources: Cavs deal Schroder for Hornets' Mann
stories.summary: The Cavaliers are trading guard Dennis Schroder and cash to the Hornets for guard Tre Mann, sources told ESPN on Friday.

stories.title: Taurasi hopes to join Mercury's ownership group
stories.summary: Two days before her No. 3 will be retired by the Phoenix Mercury, Diana Taurasi told ESPN that she hopes to join Mercury ownership in the next year or two.
